correctness.rationale: Exact squared Euclidean distances of twelve unit hexagonal-prism vertices are (0,1,3,4) at cyclic separations 0..3, plus 1 for crossing layers; hence only squared thresholds 1,2,3,4,5. At 1 graph C6□K2 has 7 loops. At squared2 six lateral tetrahedra collapse to the triangulated annulus preserving a primitive longitude and killing six loops. At squared3 the full complex has 124 nonempty faces with (12,42,52,18), 29 valid free-face pairs and an ensuing 2-complex whose 20 spanning-tree loop generators are eliminated by occurrence-once triangular relators leaving three unattached 2-cells, proving ∨3S2. At squared4 the six excluded antipodal pairs give a sixfold crosspolytope join S5; squared5 is simplex. The reduced integral barcode and interscale maps follow.
